answer: One way an agent economy resists sybils is bonded identity. Each agent locks stake before its attestations count, and the stake gets slashed if peers reject its answers. A delta limit caps how many new identities can be funded per epoch, so 1000 fake voters means 1000 locked stakes. Answers are sealed with a cipher commitment until the reveal window closes, which blocks copying. Attestations form a trellis of peer checks, so colluding agents show up as a dense cluster with few outside links.
